candidates.name: extramammary Paget disease
support_spans: Solitary, indolent, erythematous plaque in the right axilla measuring 5 × 3 cm
Dermal tumor infiltrating the subcutaneous fat without epidermal involvement
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of a slowly growing subcutaneous node in the right axilla with progressive infiltration of the overlying skin is consistent with extramammary Paget disease

candidates.name: apocrine gland carcinoma
support_spans: Multiple GATA3-positive and estrogen receptor–positive apocrine glands in close association to diffuse tumor cell infiltration
candidates.why: The presence of GATA3-positive and estrogen receptor–positive apocrine glands in close association with tumor cells suggests apocrine gland carcinoma

candidates.name: mammary analog secretory carcinoma
support_spans: Positive for: pancytokeratin (AE1/AE3), cytokeratin 20, GCDFP15, estrogen receptor, and GATA3 antibodies
candidates.why: The tumor's immunohistochemical profile is consistent with mammary analog secretory carcinoma

candidates.name: hidradenocarcinoma
support_spans: Dermal tumor infiltrating the subcutaneous fat without epidermal involvement
Tumor cells diffusely dispersed between collagen bundles and lined up in an 'Indian file pattern' with basophilic nuclei and scant cytoplasm
candidates.why: The tumor's histopathological features are consistent with hidradenocarcinoma

candidates.name: apocrine carcinoma
support_spans: Immunohistochemistry demonstrating GATA3-positive apocrine glandular structures
candidates.why: The presence of GATA3-positive apocrine glandular structures on immunohistochemistry is decisive for apocrine carcinoma

candidates.name: cutaneous metastasis of breast cancer
support_spans: 1 of the sentinel lymph nodes showed isolated cytokeratin8/18–positive tumor cells and MNF116-positive tumor cells
candidates.why: The presence of cytokeratin8/18–positive and MNF116-positive tumor cells in a sentinel lymph node is suggestive of cutaneous metastasis of breast cancer
